minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, February 15, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, February 15, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan,
  Edward Padgett and Rafaela Giles.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly and Scott Snider.

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist.

  Staff Absent: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager.

  Guest Present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, January 18,
  2023, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Grab-n-Go Meals: Meals were distributed to an average of 152 participants per week
  in January. Participants receive 7 meals each, for a total of 1,064 meals distributed.

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 19 participants per week in
  January.

  Meals on Wheels: 632 meals were served to 35 La Verne recipients in January.

4. Bingo Report: A complete report will be submitted next month.

5. Account Balance: $8,145.01.

6. Senior Program Fees: Woodcarvers not paid. All other fees have been paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Received a newsletter of classes available at discount prices.
 8. Aging Next: No report.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Meeting with the roofer regarding the leak in the back area of the
  Community Center. Veterans Hall kitchen is finished.

10. Outstanding Older American: Applications have been submitted and more will be
  submitted. We will vote at our next meeting on March 15, 2023.

11. Upcoming Events:
  - Monday, February 20th – Presidents Day, Center closed
  - Tuesday, February 21st – Excursion: Valley View Casino, 8:00 AM
  - Wednesday, February 22nd – Senior Seminar: Reverse Mortgage, 9:30
  AM
  - Monday, February 27th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  - Wednesday, March 1st – Senior Seminar: Health and Me, 9:30 AM –
  Optum Health Care
  - Thursday, March 2nd – Vaccine Booster Clinic, 10:00 AM
  - Wednesday, March 8th – Senior Seminar: Reverse Mortgage, 9:30 AM
  - Monday, March 13th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM

12. Public Comments: George gave an update on the La Verne Senior Golf League.
  They have added 3 new members for a total of 24.

13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, March 15, 2023, at 10:00 AM.
